title: Introduction to the Niche Internet
statement: The task is to order n donations (n up to 2·10^5, values may be negative) so that exactly k are at least the average of all earlier ones, i.e. exactly k steps where the prefix average does not decrease. Copies of the maximum always count, so the answer is NO when k is below their number; otherwise the k largest values ascending, then the rest descending, hit exactly k.
